summary: This clinical trial is testing a chrono nutrition diet compared to a standard diet for adults with type 2 diabetes who are overweight or have obesity. Chrono nutrition is a meal timing and meal planning approach that involves specific fasting hours and food order. Researchers want to see how these different diet plans affect insulin resistance, which is how the body handles sugar in the blood. The study plans to enroll 40 participants.

facts.sponsor: Instituto Nacional de Ciencias Medicas y Nutricion Salvador Zubiran
